title: Security alert (M10)
brief: Security alert screen of goop, opened from an offer the Security agent (gpt-oss-safeguard-20b) flagged, or from the status line alert: offer header with a pink ⚠ quarantined tag and the reason category; the flagged lines quoted as inert plain text with the rule that fired; what goop did (lines removed from the summary and prompts, offer out of the ranking, nothing sent); the decision as key hints (enter keep quarantined, r release, d dismiss, b block company/source, f full text, esc back, ? all actions); status line with the alert focus mode. Below the screen: the status line alert chip and the toast after release.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Consistent with M2 and room for full quotes and goop's advice; hides the chat and the list while you decide
